text: {"findings":[{"kind":"user-preference","slug":"spawn-workers-in-new-tabs","title":"Use new tabs within the existing workspace","content":"Johan wants agents spawned as new tabs in the existing workspace, not in separate workspaces; completed tabs or workspaces should be fully closed, and the active screen should be verified by screenshot.","sources":["68714bd8-a740-422c-a02d-a077db5beb33"]},{"kind":"procedure","slug":"never-reuse-finished-worker-sessions","title":"Launch a fresh worker for every ticket","content":"When a ticket finishes, close its worker tab/session. Start each new ticket in a brand-new tab with a fresh Claude/Codex process; never reuse a finished worker session.","sources":["e2bf6f32-543b-4bfe-b999-a8d144587c6a"]}]}

{"findings":[{"kind":"user-preference","slug":"defer-cmux-upgrade","title":"Defer cmux upgrade","content":"Johan prefers to postpone the cmux upgrade until the end when possible.","sources":["b7cbbcf0-95a8-4d38-a9b1-53f625f0b5d9","22a0c52d-e9a7-4050-90af-29f2a5212cfc"]},{"kind":"user-preference","slug":"autonomous-completion","title":"Minimize required involvement","content":"Johan wants the remaining work fully built with no further action required from him if possible.","sources":["22a0c52d-e9a7-4050-90af-29f2a5212cfc"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"v1-build-tickets-near-complete","title":"V1 build was near completion","content":"At the recorded checkpoint, 17 of 18 build tickets were complete; ticket #35 was closed and #36, the v1 live acceptance run, remained in progress as a headless worker.","sources":["05a8b12e-dec2-402f-a010-6af5efc90f91"]}]}

{"findings":[{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"retro-scope-drift-signal","title":"Retro scope-drift signal ships in v1","content":"Argus v1 includes a third Retro-eye signal that compares a registered ticket session’s diff with the ticket’s stated scope, reusing existing git attribution, evidence caps, gh access, composition, and tracker-filing plumbing.","sources":["318d8036-d693-42f4-b49e-c6251b06f499"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"scope-drift-false-positive-policy","title":"Scope-drift detection uses a conservative false-positive policy","content":"Scope drift files only when the evidence supports two booleans plus articulated prose; thin or ambiguous scope produces silence, with burden of proof on drift and a named safe list.","sources":["318d8036-d693-42f4-b49e-c6251b06f499"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"argus-test-suite-status-2026-08-25","title":"Argus tests and typecheck passed after scope-drift work","content":"After ticket #38, typecheck passed and the test suite reported 571 passing, 2 skipped, and 0 failing tests.","sources":["318d8036-d693-42f4-b49e-c6251b06f499"]}]}

{"findings":[{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"hermes-live-verification-profile-blocker","title":"Hermes live verification has an environment blocker","content":"Hermes live verification can silently skip indefinitely when no profile exists to read; this was filed as issue #47.","sources":["16b138ea-f5bf-4ed2-9f86-7aefc9ca385b"]},{"kind":"procedure","slug":"watchdog-loop-state-heartbeat","title":"Use loop-state files as watchdog heartbeats","content":"For watchdog health checks, use the dispatcher's loop-state file as the loop heartbeat instead of fingerprinting worker processes.","sources":["16b138ea-f5bf-4ed2-9f86-7aefc9ca385b"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"claimed-tickets-can-become-orphaned","title":"Claimed tickets can remain orphaned after worker exit","content":"The project has experienced claimed tickets with no live process after agents committed work, indicating that closure can silently fail or workers can die mid-task.","sources":["b1ce4b37-9100-4799-ac5c-1dbcd9535400"]}]}

{"findings":[{"kind":"user-preference","slug":"spawn-workers-in-new-tabs","title":"Spawn each agent in a new tab within the existing workspace","content":"Johan wants spawned agents to open as new tabs in the existing workspace, not create new workspaces.","sources":["68714bd8-a740-422c-a02d-a077db5beb33"]},{"kind":"user-preference","slug":"close-finished-worker-tabs","title":"Fully close tabs when work finishes","content":"Johan wants completed agent tabs or workspaces closed fully after their work is done.","sources":["68714bd8-a740-422c-a02d-a077db5beb33"]},{"kind":"user-preference","slug":"never-reuse-finished-worker-session","title":"Never reuse a finished worker session for a new ticket","content":"Johan requires every new ticket to use a brand-new tab and fresh Claude/Codex process; finished worker sessions must not receive new ticket prompts.","sources":["e2bf6f32-543b-4bfe-b999-a8d144587c6a"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"dispatcher-five-minute-cadence","title":"Dispatcher runs on a five-minute cadence","content":"The project’s dispatcher operates on a five-minute cadence.","sources":["c2b83ece-1e62-40b1-886e-817f6c6087aa"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"four-tab-monitoring-layout","title":"Current monitoring layout uses four tabs","content":"The active setup had exactly four tabs: monitoring, dispatcher, and two worker tabs.","sources":["c2b83ece-1e62-40b1-886e-817f6c6087aa"]}]}

{"findings":[{"kind":"user-preference","slug":"isolated-opus-and-codex-testing","title":"Use isolated models for testing","content":"Johan wants system testing to use Opus 5 in isolation and Codex high-effort in isolation.","sources":["cadb625e-9f16-4966-a027-13f40454705f"]},{"kind":"user-preference","slug":"avoid-anthropic-api-models","title":"Do not rely on Anthropic API models","content":"Johan considers Anthropic models via API unusable because his subscription does not permit that, so alternatives should be considered.","sources":["9792035e-2532-4744-b6f2-2c17bbf924ea"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"cmux-version-required-for-acceptance","title":"Acceptance requires cmux 0.64.22 or newer","content":"The project’s full v1 proof depends on cmux version 0.64.22 or newer; older version 0.62.2 prevents one acceptance scenario from running.","sources":["136f4906-ef11-49ba-87fa-00f0752f65a5"]},{"kind":"procedure","slug":"upgrade-and-verify-cmux","title":"Upgrade cmux before acceptance testing","content":"Fully quit cmux with ⌘Q, reopen it, use the update banner if still present, then verify `cmux version` is at least 0.64.22.","sources":["136f4906-ef11-49ba-87fa-00f0752f65a5"]}]}

{"findings":[{"kind":"user-preference","slug":"defer-cmux-upgrade","title":"Defer cmux upgrade","content":"Johan prefers to defer the cmux upgrade until the end when possible.","sources":["b7cbbcf0-95a8-4d38-a9b1-53f625f0b5d9"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"v1-build-nearly-complete","title":"V1 build nearly complete","content":"The project had 17 of 18 build tickets completed; only ticket #36, the v1 live acceptance run, remained and was executing as a healthy headless worker on 2026-08-25.","sources":["05a8b12e-dec2-402f-a010-6af5efc90f91"]}]}

{"findings":[{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"argus-watch-ticket-39-running","title":"Argus watch implementation was actively running","content":"Ticket #39, implementing `argus watch <eye>` for all five eyes, was actively running with real commits in its worktree.","sources":["b1ce4b37-9100-4799-ac5c-1dbcd9535400"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"orphaned-claimed-tickets","title":"Claimed tickets can become orphaned after committing","content":"Tickets #38 and #40 were observed marked claimed without live processes, despite having committed work; this indicates a durable failure mode where agents finish or die after committing but before closure, leaving tickets orphaned.","sources":["b1ce4b37-9100-4799-ac5c-1dbcd9535400"]},{"kind":"procedure","slug":"dispatcher-loop-state-heartbeat","title":"Use dispatcher loop-state as watchdog heartbeat","content":"The watchdog should use the dispatcher's loop-state file as the loop heartbeat instead of fingerprinting worker processes, which may be unreliable when many Claude sessions are active.","sources":["16b138ea-f5bf-4ed2-9f86-7aefc9ca385b"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"hermes-verification-profile-blocker","title":"Hermes live verification can silently skip without a profile","content":"Hermes live verification silently skips when no profile exists to read; this environment blocker was filed as ticket #47.","sources":["16b138ea-f5bf-4ed2-9f86-7aefc9ca385b"]}]}

{"findings":[{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"retro-scope-drift-signal","title":"Retro scope-drift signal ships in v1","content":"Argus v1 includes a third Retro-eye signal that evaluates whether a registered ticket session's diff matches the ticket's requested scope, reusing existing git attribution, evidence caps, gh scope lookup, composition, and tracker-filing plumbing.","sources":["ca974261-deb8-4953-bbc2-22b0f41dcb1a","318d8036-d693-42f4-b49e-c6251b06f499"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"scope-drift-false-positive-policy","title":"Scope-drift detection favors audited silence","content":"Scope drift requires two affirmative model decisions plus articulated prose; ambiguity, insufficient scope, or brain errors produce no filing, and cap slots are released on every path.","sources":["318d8036-d693-42f4-b49e-c6251b06f499"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"argus-test-suite-status","title":"Argus validation gates passed","content":"After the scope-drift implementation, TypeScript typechecking passed and the test suite reported 571 passing, 2 skipped, and 0 failing tests.","sources":["318d8036-d693-42f4-b49e-c6251b06f499"]},{"kind":"procedure","slug":"scope-drift-validation-loop","title":"Validate both directions of scope drift","content":"Test both in-scope and drift cases using the real prompt builder and schema validation, then run the full Retro suite, typecheck, and complete test suite before handoff.","sources":["7ae319f3-6c64-4427-a37a-4ce8c318e1c7","09b305e9-4f6a-498b-b7e8-cc3133a29384","318d8036-d693-42f4-b49e-c6251b06f499"]}]}

{"findings":[{"kind":"user-preference","slug":"avoid-anthropic-api-models","title":"Anthropic API models are unavailable for Johan","content":"Johan considers Anthropic models via API unusable because his subscription does not permit access, so alternatives should be considered.","sources":["9792035e-2532-4744-b6f2-2c17bbf924ea"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"isolated-opus-and-codex-testing","title":"Testing uses isolated Opus and Codex workers","content":"The project testing workflow uses Claude Opus 5 and Codex workers in isolation, with Opus configured at maximum effort.","sources":["cadb625e-9f16-4966-a027-13f40454705f","3f3601d9-33d5-401e-9b2d-9a2327be72b5"]},{"kind":"procedure","slug":"upgrade-cmux-and-verify-version","title":"Upgrade cmux before acceptance validation","content":"Fully quit and reopen cmux, apply any pending restart update, then verify `cmux version` is at least 0.64.22 before running the complete acceptance workflow.","sources":["136f4906-ef11-49ba-87fa-00f0752f65a5"]}]}

{"findings":[{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"v1-live-acceptance-run-was-final-build-ticket","title":"V1 build was nearly complete","content":"As of 2026-08-25, 17 of 18 build tickets were complete; ticket #36, the v1 live acceptance run, was the only remaining ticket and was executing as a healthy headless worker.","sources":["05a8b12e-dec2-402f-a010-6af5efc90f91"]},{"kind":"procedure","slug":"preload-dispatcher-brief-with-verified-facts","title":"Pre-load dispatcher briefs with verified facts","content":"When dispatching a worker for an acceptance or verification task, pre-load its brief with already-verified facts so the worker can focus on proving the remaining claims instead of re-deriving context.","sources":["05a8b12e-dec2-402f-a010-6af5efc90f91"]}]}

{"findings":[{"kind":"user-preference","slug":"spawn-workers-in-new-tabs-same-workspace","title":"Spawn workers as new tabs in the existing workspace","content":"Johan wants newly spawned agents to open as new tabs within the existing workspace, rather than creating additional workspaces.","sources":["68714bd8-a740-422c-a02d-a077db5beb33"]},{"kind":"user-preference","slug":"close-finished-worker-tabs","title":"Fully close completed worker tabs","content":"Johan wants tabs or workspaces closed fully when their work is finished, while allowing currently active work to continue.","sources":["68714bd8-a740-422d-a077db5beb33"]},{"kind":"user-preference","slug":"never-reuse-finished-worker-sessions","title":"Never reuse finished worker sessions","content":"Johan wants every new ticket assigned to a brand-new tab and fresh agent process; completed worker sessions must not be reused.","sources":["e2bf6f32-543b-4bfe-b999-a8d144587c6a"]},{"kind":"procedure","slug":"verify-tab-hygiene-visually","title":"Verify workspace tab hygiene by screenshot","content":"After managing agent tabs, verify the actual screen visually with a screenshot to confirm the intended workspace and tab state.","sources":["68714bd8-a740-422c-a02d-a077db5beb33"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"dispatcher-five-minute-cadence","title":"Dispatcher runs on a five-minute cadence","content":"The project’s agent workflow includes a dispatcher operating on a five-minute cadence.","sources":["c2b83ece-1e62-40b1-886e-817f6c6087aa"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"four-tab-monitoring-layout","title":"Current monitoring layout uses four tabs","content":"At the cited point, the active setup had exactly four tabs: monitoring, dispatcher, and two worker tabs.","sources":["c2b83ece-1e62-40b1-886e-817f6c6087aa"]}]}

{"findings":[{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"retro-scope-drift-signal-shipped","title":"Retro scope-drift signal was implemented","content":"Argus v1 added a third Retro-eye signal that evaluates whether a registered ticket session's diff matches the ticket's requested scope, reusing existing git attribution, evidence caps, GitHub scope lookup, composition, and tracker filing paths.","sources":["ca974261-deb8-4953-bbc2-22b0f41dcb1a","318d8036-d693-42f4-b49e-c6251b06f499"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"scope-drift-conservative-false-positive-policy","title":"Scope-drift detection uses a conservative filing policy","content":"Scope drift is filed only when both required boolean findings and supporting prose meet the burden of proof; named safe cases and ambiguity result in silence, and scopes too thin to measure never reach the brain.","sources":["7ae319f3-6c64-4427-a37a-4ce8c318e1c7","318d8036-d693-42f4-b49e-c6251b06f499"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"retro-suite-green-after-scope-drift","title":"The retro suite and typecheck passed","content":"After the scope-drift implementation, the reported verification was TypeScript no-emit success and 571 tests passing, with 2 skipped and 0 failures.","sources":["09b305e9-4f6a-498b-b7e8-cc3133a29384","318d8036-d693-42f4-b49e-c6251b06f499"]},{"kind":"procedure","slug":"degrade-brain-errors-to-audited-silence","title":"Treat thrown brain errors as silent watcher failures","content":"For the drift watcher, brain exceptions are converted to the same audited silence as an unsuccessful brain response, and the evidence-cap slot is released on every path.","sources":["318d8036-d693-42f4-b49e-c6251b06f499"]}]}

{"findings":[{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"argus-has-five-eyes","title":"Argus has five eyes","content":"The Argus project defines five eyes, with ticket #39 covering implementation of `argus watch <eye>` for all five.","sources":["b1ce4b37-9100-4799-ac5c-1dbcd9535400"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"watchdog-uses-loop-state-heartbeat","title":"Watchdog heartbeat uses dispatcher loop state","content":"The watchdog was replaced to use the dispatcher's loop-state file as the loop heartbeat instead of fingerprinting worker processes.","sources":["16b138ea-f5bf-4ed2-9f86-7aefc9ca385b"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"hermes-live-verification-can-skip-without-profile","title":"Hermes verification can silently skip without a profile","content":"Hermes live verification has an environment blocker: it can silently skip forever when no profile exists to read; this was filed as issue #47.","sources":["16b138ea-f5bf-4ed2-9f86-7aefc9ca385b"]},{"kind":"procedure","slug":"recover-orphaned-claimed-tickets-after-process-loss","title":"Recover claimed tickets whose workers disappeared","content":"When a ticket is marked claimed but has no live process, inspect its worktree for commits and determine whether the work completed but closure failed or the worker died after committing, then recover the lane accordingly.","sources":["b1ce4b37-9100-4799-ac5c-1dbcd9535400"]}]}

{"findings":[{"kind":"user-preference","slug":"avoid-anthropic-api-models","title":"Avoid Anthropic API models","content":"Johan considers Anthropic models via API unusable because his subscription does not allow them, so alternatives should be considered.","sources":["9792035e-2532-4744-b6f2-2c17bbf924ea"]},{"kind":"user-preference","slug":"isolated-opus-and-codex-testing","title":"Use isolated models for testing","content":"Johan wants system testing to use Opus 5 in isolation and Codex Sol high in isolation.","sources":["cadb625e-9f16-4966-a027-13f40454705f"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"cmux-version-required-for-acceptance","title":"Acceptance requires cmux 0.64.22 or newer","content":"The project’s full v1 acceptance cannot be proven on cmux 0.62.2; cmux version 0.64.22 or newer is required for one of the ten acceptance scenarios.","sources":["136f4906-ef11-49ba-87fa-00f0752f65a5"]},{"kind":"procedure","slug":"upgrade-and-verify-cmux","title":"Upgrade and verify cmux","content":"Fully quit cmux with ⌘Q, reopen it, activate the “Update installed · Restart to update” banner if it remains, then run `cmux version` and verify the result is at least 0.64.22.","sources":["136f4906-ef11-49ba-87fa-00f0752f65a5"]}]}

Scope too thin to measure does not reach the brain.","sources":["318d8036-d693-42f4-b49e-c6251b06f499"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"scope-drift-test-gates-green","title":"Scope-drift implementation passes current gates","content":"The implementation passed TypeScript checking and the test suite with 571 passing tests, 2 skipped, and 0 failures; all 8 drift cases were green.","sources":["5a4586ff-813d-4c31-846d-1a6a82df8e33","318d8036-d693-42f4-b49e-c6251b06f499"]},{"kind":"project-fact","slug":"drift-brain-errors-degrade-to-silence","title":"Brain exceptions are handled as audited silence","content":"If the drift pass Brain throws instead of returning ok:false, the watcher now degrades to the same audited silence and releases its cap slot on every path.","sources":["318d8036-d693-42f4-b49e-c6251b06f499"]}]}

text: {"findings":[{"kind":"procedure","slug":"extend-an-existing-signal-pipeline-with-policy-and-gates","title":"Extend an existing signal pipeline with policy-first tests and integration gates","content":"When adding a new signal to an established detection pipeline, first read the ticket, decision context, specification, and the complete existing implementation. Reuse the existing plumbing and seams instead of duplicating infrastructure. Encode the false-positive policy explicitly, test both positive and negative directions before implementation, and keep ambiguous or unmeasurable cases silent. Add schema-level tests for required fields, run focused tests plus the full suite and typecheck, exercise the real prompt/model integration at the intended effort level, and ensure thrown dependencies degrade to audited silence while releasing any reserved capacity. Update the specification to describe the shipped behavior and policy, then verify registration and ordering in the shared registry.","sources":["ca974261-deb8-4953-bbc2-22b0f41dcb1a","7ae319f3-6c64-4427-a37a-4ce8c318e1c7","5a4586ff-813d-4c31-846d-1a6a82df8e33","09b305e9-4f6a-498b-b7e8-cc3133a29384","318d8036-d693-42f4-b49e-c6251b06f499"]}]}
